name: Frontiers Hide Author Name
author: Edwin Bekedam

sections.description:
Do you want to hide and disable the comment author link in WordPress and hide the real user author name from the blog post?
This is a plugin that is minimalist with not much code; only PHP and little CSS will be inlined to ensure that the author
is no longer visible to for the public visitor.

This plugin works intergrated with following WP-plugins.

Yoast SEO,WP Seo, The SEO Framework, AIOSEO, Slim SEO, Rank Math, Astra Themes, Genesis Themes

Remove author from general WordPress and author meta from AMP, and removed Storefront author credit.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘simply-hide-author.zip’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Extract the Plugin to ‘frontiers-hide-author-name’ Folder
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

  4. no settings need – just Activate and enjoy.

  5. Go to ‘Plugins’ in the Admin menu

  6. Click on the button ‘Add new’
  7. Search for ‘frontiers-hide-author-name’ and click ‘Install Now’ or click on the upload link to upload ‘simply-hide-author-name.zip’
  8. Click on ‘Activate plugin’
sections.faq:
Witch SEO plugins work togetter witch Frontiers Hide Author Name ?

Yoast SEO,WP Seo, The SEO Framework, AIOSEO, Rank Math, Slim SEO

Does Frontiers Hide Author Name has any intergrations with other Themes?

Yes, o.a. with Astra Themes , Genesis Themes, Elegant Themes, Twenty Twelve, Twenty Twenty-One

Will  Frontiers Hide Author Name function correctly with more recent PHP versions? 

It has indeed been tested using the latest version of PHP 8.4.
